segments.t: While Fedya teases Senya with a piece of ice for his fake toothache, Kostya tells Max that Nagiyev is a serious rival for Vika's heart. Listen to the full conversation in Russian first, and then we will walk through every line together.
Да я тебе говорю, надо полоскать.
Да, соперник у тебя, конечно, серьёзный.
Хорошо, что ему Настя не нравится.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Да я тебе говорю, надо полоскать.
'I am telling you, you need to rinse.' Fedya brings out the contrast between 'yes' and 'I' in a few short words.
'Your medicine will not help at all.' Fedya brings out the contrast between 'your' and 'medicine' in a few short words.
'Right here is real cold ice.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'here' before landing on 'ice'.
'Here, you can check for yourself.' Fedya brings out the contrast between 'on' and 'here' in a few short words.
'Well, have you checked already?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'come on' before landing on 'checked'.
Да, соперник у тебя, конечно, серьёзный.
'Yes, your rival is certainly serious.' Kostya brings out the contrast between 'yes' and 'rival' in a few short words.
Хорошо, что ему Настя не нравится.
'It is good that he does not like Nastya.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'pleases' to negate the statement.
'I will go talk with him calmly.' In Russian, the idea of 'will go' flows naturally into 'will talk' without extra filler words.
'Max, wait, where are you going?' Kostya raises the pitch on 'are going' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question. Max answers right away.
'Dmitry Vladimirovich, are you free right now?' Max brings out the contrast between 'you' and 'now' in a few short words.
'Let me call you back later.' In Russian, the idea of 'give' flows naturally into 'will call back' without extra filler words.
'We need to talk seriously.' Max brings out the contrast between 'us' and 'needed' in a few short words. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Да я тебе говорю, надо полоскать.
Да, соперник у тебя, конечно, серьёзный.
Хорошо, что ему Настя не нравится.
Max marches straight up to Nagiyev's table to settle things man to man, only to learn something unexpected. Until next time!
